text:
mina: Hey — after the perf run this morning I noticed the embeddings endpoint can return results out-of-order when we autosplit mixed-dim batches. e.g. client sends 8 items with dims [768,512,768,768,512,512,768,512], splitter shards them and the client-visible ordering changes. Anyone seen this?

raj: Yep seen similar in local tests. Root cause looks like the splitter assigns subrequests and we reassemble by arrival time instead of original index in a tiny path where preflight was disabled.

sasha: Oof. We should add a deterministic reassembly field in the split plan from the service side (index_map) so clients can reorder reliably. Also need telemetry for reorder events.

raj: Proposed minimal preflight contract: service returns a plan header mapping indices -> route shards. Example:```json
{"plan": [{"orig_idx":0,"shard":"r1"},{"orig_idx":1,"shard":"r2"}, ...]}```Client can opt-in by sending header `X-Embed-Preflight: 1`. Plan is immutable for the request.

mina: Good. Two followups: 1) perf impact of preflight (extra RTT) and 2) telemetry/console UX for operators to see reorder_rate + perf delta. My preference: enable preflight server-side and expose plan only to clients that opt in so we can canary it.

sasha: Telemetry events I'd add: `embed.splitter.plan_created` (tags: tenant, route_variant, split_count, total_bytes), `embed.splitter.reorder_detected` (tags: tenant, route_variant, orig_indices_sample, reorder_distance), and `embed.splitter.plan_latency_ms`. Sampling: store full orig_indices only on sampled traces (1%) to avoid huge logs. Dashboards: preflight_success_rate, reorder_rate_by_dim, avg_split_size, p50/p95/p99 assemble_latency.

raj: Implementation note: preflight adds ~100-250us on median for small payloads (we measured in staging). For large batches it helps avoid costly client retries. Suggest compressing plan JSON (gz or base64) to keep header sizes down; or put plan in response body for streaming clients. Also we should consider returning `X-Embed-Plan-Hash` so clients can quickly check plan freshness.

mina: Rollout plan idea: console flag `embeds.splitter.preflight` (default off). Start with 5% org canary -> monitor reorder_rate and assemble_latency for 48h -> 25% -> 100%. Gate by reorder_rate drop >=50% and p99 assemble_lat increase <= 10%.

tom: SDK change required: bump client to 0.12.2 with automatic reordering using `plan.orig_idx`. Also add fast-fail: if reassembled order != original and reorder_distance > threshold (e.g., >3 positions) then return 422 with `embed.reorder` error so caller can surface to app.

carla: For quotas: preflight requests count as metadata calls. We should not double-bill tokens for the plan. Propose a lightweight quota bucket `embeds:preflight` with much lower weight. Might need billing input.

eng-bot: canary deployed to staging cluster `staging-embeds-2` with flag `embeds.splitter.preflight=true` for orgs [testcorp, sandbox-42].

mina: sg. @raj @sasha can you pair on a small PR that: adds the plan header, emits the telemetry events, and toggles the console flag? Keep the API backwards compatible (opt-in).

raj: Will do. I'll open RFC + PR today.

sasha: I'll wire the dashboards and add alerting on reorder_rate > 0.1% by tenant. :thumbsup:

mina: Thanks everyone — will track in the rollout board.
